premises.text: Person-to-person bill support still largely uses cash and check with last-mile diversion and no co-payer visibility
premises.evidence_span: Once I give them that money, it may not end up at its intended destination

premises.text: PayTap lets multiple people collaborate on a bill with funds going directly to the biller without requiring accounts
premises.evidence_span: We allow people to collaborate and contribute towards a bill with the money going directly to the biller

premises.text: Contributors choose amount and payment method while keeping financial details private and FDIC-insured
premises.evidence_span: no one gets to see my financial information

premises.text: Shared visibility, alerts, recurring payments, and private-mode invites coordinate family and roommate bill payment
premises.evidence_span: we can collaborate together to make sure everything gets paid, nothing falls between the cracks

premises.text: Merchant integrations such as Amazon let groups split purchase cost until fully funded then ship
premises.evidence_span: you can add an item from Amazon directly into Paytap

premises.text: Distribution via web, Facebook, mobile apps and by letting billers and merchants offer PayTap to users
premises.evidence_span: we're allowing billers and online merchants to offer Paytap to their users so that they can get payments made

value.text: Elegant shared payment that removes stress and hassle by sending money straight to the biller
value.evidence_span: we're the definition of elegant organisation for shared payment

causal_links.evidence_span: We take out the stress, the steps, and all the hassle involved in making payments
when everyone has paid their amounts, the money goes off to Amazon

notes: Market size $865B treated as context for P2P problem; mechanism coded not the number as traction. Cross-border remittance mention left as market scope framing within value narrative, not a separate premise. Amazon integration split as distinct merchant module.
